party_a_statement: My landlord B deducted 30000 INR from my 50000 INR security deposit citing normal repainting costs after 2 years of tenancy.
party_b_statement: The tenant scratched walls and stained carpets. Repainting cost me 30000 INR.

evidence.text: Clause 8: Normal wear and tear shall not be deducted from the security deposit upon lease termination.

evidence.description: Move-out inspection photos showing clean walls
evidence.text: Move-out timestamped inspection photographs: Walls intact, clean condition with negligible routine scuffs.
